msg: No top-level <masterLabel>. The topic deploys without a name and the planner cannot list it.
No top-level <description>. The planner routes on this text, so the topic is never selected.
No <scope>. Nothing bounds the topic, so the agent answers questions it was never meant to touch. Add a one-line topic boundary.
<scope> is under 40 characters. Too thin to bound the topic; say what the agent must refuse.
No <genAiPluginInstructions> block. The topic carries no behaviour at all.
Two instructions share one <developerName>. Rename the duplicate or the metadata deploy fails.
Generated placeholder text left in an instruction. Replace it before the agent reads it to a customer.
A <functionName> is never named in any instruction or in <scope>. Name it so the planner picks it.
No instruction tells the person they are talking to an AI. EU AI Act Article 50(1) has applied since 2026-08-02; the Article 99(4) ceiling is 15 million euro or 3 percent of worldwide turnover.
An instruction carries contact or identity data. Instruction text is sent to the model on every turn; move it out of the prompt.
An instruction points at a plain http:// address. Use a Named Credential over https.
A bare & that is not an XML entity. Escape it as & or the deploy stops on a parse error.
<apiVersion> predates 62.0, the release Agentforce topics shipped in. Raise it to 62.0 or later.
